store.howToUseVouchers: How to use your vouchers at checkout?
store.howToUseVouchersSteps:
1. When creating an order in the Store for a patient, make sure the lab matches the voucher issuer.
2. In the cart, enter your voucher code corresponding to the service type.
3. The service value will be fully covered up to your voucher balance. Any additional items will be billed normally.
4. If the cart only contains items covered by active vouchers, the order will be sent directly to the lab without payment!
